nodes.title: kon/place gate 2 (claude/r8-gate2-place; naming still off until main removes it from NAMING_OFF). join-wrong-end: the law writes no sign fact; one press is an ordinary miss at chance weight with nothing in facts, seam, trail or rows; because a pair of blind joins is 1 in 4, the server names it only on the fourth sighting on four different asked sizes with both join orders among them ((1/2)^4 = 1 in 16; a one-place pressing habit never qualifies): FamilyLogic.chanceRepeat, levels.js repeatMet (the shared one-prior rule unchanged when no spec), kon draw surface parts [asked size, join order] (drawSurface), CHANCE_MEMORY 6. vertex-off: named within VO_BAND = 10 board units of the bottom-edge pose (base within 3 degrees of an arm), i.e. 14-34 units from O; was 11. wrong-scale: measure key 140 refused and no wrong-scale named at a placed reading in SCALE_SLIP_READS (16, 140, 141, 159, 164-166), where one pad typing slip lands on the other scale's number over 1 in 10. Reverse if: a judge shows a single ordinary slip (other than a mis-press onto the other join button, flagged to main) landing in a band over 1 in 10 on a served level; or children's mis-presses on the join buttons are measured common (then the join becomes a drawn ruler line, a constructed act).

kon/place gate 2 proof, computed in tests/r8-games-kon-place-gate2.test.mjs over n = 178 measure + 179 draw generated levels (fades 1-3, 8 seeds). Method: bands checked against the law's predicates (72 directions in/out, turn +-3 in, +-4 out); blind = admitted turns x disc area / (board area x 360), an upper bound; slips = nudge (1 unit, 4 ways) and turn (1 degree) from 3,024 placements on the tolerance edge per level; drop curve = the right turn, centre evenly over a disc of radius r round O, 0.25-unit grid; typing = pad keys touching (6 columns), swap, missed, doubled, as the pad takes them. Results: vertex-off blind 1 in 8,905 (board) / 1 in 2,835 (near O), slips 0, drop worst 1 in 10.8 (r = 30; 1 in 9.3 at the old 11). centre-on-arm blind worst 1 in 390 (near O, measure), slips 0, drop worst 1 in 54. wrong-scale blind 1 in 36; typing worst 1 in 14 (key 155), 1 in 16 (110), else 0; 140 was 1 in 9 (refused). join-wrong-end 1 in 2 per level, 1 in 4 a pair, 1 in 16 on four.
